prompt: As of August 3 2024, which surviving building of the World's Columbian Exposition of 1893 sits on the same street as a skyscraper over 1,000 feet tall? Give the surviving building's current name.
answer: The surviving building is the **Art Institute of Chicago**, formerly the **World’s Congress Auxiliary Building** of the 1893 exposition. It stands at **111 South Michigan Avenue**, the same street as **875 North Michigan Avenue (the former John Hancock Center)**, which rises more than 1,000 feet.
